title: Youth programs below their participant target two years running
question: Which programs served under 90% of the participants they projected in both years, and what happened to their grants?
finding: 15 programs fell short in both years; 15 of them had the same or a larger grant in 2025-26. Lowest: Community Education Partnerships - One-on-One Academic Tutoring for McKinney-Vento Students (16%, 28%); Friendship House Association of American Indians - Friendship House Youth Program (35%, 21%); Bayview Hunters Point YMCA - CARE Middle School - Bayview (40%, 37%).
how: The enrolment measure's result on both years' pages; grants as printed on the pages.
limits: The 2024-29 grants are multi-year awards with a cost-of-living step, so an unchanged grant is the default, not a decision to reward a shortfall. Projections can be set high; a small program can miss by a few young people.
